text: The female genital tract of the cow has several parts: two ovaries, one on the right and one on the left, each suspended by a ligament; the oviduct, a small canal from the ovaries to the uterus about 25 cm long and less than 1 cm in diameter; the uterus, which has 2 horns; the cervix, the 'door' to the uterus, which can be open or closed; the vagina, into which the bladder duct opens at the bottom; and the vulva, the external part of the reproductive tract.
